entries.title: Schedule Daily Workplace Reports
body: A Daily option is added for the Time Period and Schedule drop-down menus when adding a new Workplace Report.
See image.
To learn more, see Scheduling Workplace Reports.

entries.title: Customizing Views with Data Explorer
body: Use Data Explorer to build your own customized views of metrics to analyze data and save them as scheduled reports in the Business Insights Admin Portal.
See image.
To learn more, see Configuring Data Explorer Views, Scheduling Data Explorer Reports, and About Data Explorer Reports.

entries.title: Filtering Options for Applications
body: You can filter insights on the All Applications page using the following options: Data Source, Growth Trend, ACV, Risk Index, Departments, Alternatives, Purchased Seats, Sanction Status, Contract Start Date, Contract End Date, or Tags.
See image.
To learn more, see About All Applications.

entries.title: Exporting Footfall Data
body: The Export button is added to the Footfall by the Time of the Day section for you to download the data as a CSV file when analyzing a workplace for a specific week or the last 7 days.
See image.
To learn more, see Analyzing a Workplace.

entries.title: Support to Tag Applications and Contracts
body: You can use the Application Tags and Contract Tags features to link applications and contracts to user-defined tags. These tags can be used as a filtering option for viewing applications and contracts, respectively.
See image.
To learn more, see About Application Tags and About Contract Tags.

entries.title: Filtering Footfall Data for a Workplace
body: When you select a 3-month time range for a workplace to analyze, you can select any 1 of 3 months to view insights for the Footfall by the Time of the Day section.
See image.
To learn more, see Analyzing a Workplace.

entries.title: Enhanced Offices and Discovered Locations
body: The following enhancements are available in the Business Insights Admin Portal for improved management of offices and discovered locations:
- The Configured Offices page is renamed to the Offices page and moved under the Offices and Locations menu (Workplace > Offices and Locations > Offices).
- See image.
- The Offices and Locations page is renamed to the Discovered Locations page (Workplace > Offices and Locations > Discovered Locations).
- See image.
To learn more, see About Discovered Locations and About Offices.

entries.title: Discover and View Insights for All ZIA Applications
body: You can view insights for all applications discovered from the ZIA data source instead of the current top 700 curated applications. If you choose to view all applications from the ZIA data source, the Users Overlap section becomes unavailable on the Application Overlap Details page (Application > Overlapping Apps > click on the application).
See image.
This feature is in limited availability. To access this feature, contact your Zscaler Account team.

entries.title: Support for Uploading Contracts to View Insights
body: You can upload application contracts established with your vendor to view insights such as application annual contract value (ACV), total contract value (TCV), spending overview, various deadlines, and more.
See image.
To learn more, see About Contracts, Uploading Application Contracts, About the Processing Queue, Viewing Contract Details, Contract Settings, and Managing Queued Contracts.

entries.title: Support to Schedule Workplace Reports
body: You can schedule attendance reports with various criteria for distribution to multiple email recipients.
See image.
To learn more, see About Workplace Reports and Scheduling Workplace Reports.

entries.title: Support to Tag Workplaces
body: You can use the Tag Management feature to link workplaces to user-defined tags. These tags can be used as a filtering option for viewing workplace insights.
See image.
To learn more, see About Tag Management and Adding Tag Categories.

entries.title: View State and Country Information for Workplaces
body: You can view the state and country information for workplaces on the Offices and Locations page.
See image.
To learn more, see About Offices and Locations.

entries.title: Configuring Offices via CSV Template No Longer Supported
body: The ability to upload CSV files to configure offices is no longer available in the Business Insights Admin Portal. However, you can use the Add Office option on the Configured Offices page (Workplace > Workplace Settings) to configure offices.
See image.

entries.title: New Columns in the Offices and Locations Table
body: You can view the IP addresses and ZIA location associated with a workplace on the Offices and Locations page.
See image.
To learn more, see About Offices and Locations.

entries.title: Support for Mapping Departments to a Division
body: You can map departments to a division and view workplace insights based on the division.
See image.
To learn more, see About Department Mapping and Mapping Departments.

entries.title: Support for Role-Based Administration
body: The Business Insights service supports role-based administration that allows you to configure admins based on their work role and scope in the Business Insights Admin Portal.
To learn more, see Configuring Role-Based Administration.

entries.title: Support to Export All Applications Page
body: You can export the data in the All Applications page to a CSV file.
See image.
To learn more, see About All Applications.

entries.title: Configure Attendance and Occupancy Goals for Workplaces
body: You can configure the occupancy and attendance goals at the organization and office levels. This feature introduces the following updates to the Business Insights Admin Portal:
- A new tab, Occupancy and Attendance Goals, is added to the Workplace Settings page (Workplace > Workplace Settings > Occupancy and Attendance Goals).
- See image.
- Two new column fields, Occupancy Goal and Attendance Goal, are added to the Configured Offices page (Workplace > Workplace Settings > Configured Offices).
- See image.
- Two new fields, Occupancy Goal Percentage and Attendance Goal Percentage, are added to the Add Office and Edit Office drawers.
- See image.
To learn more, see Configuring Organization-Level Occupancy & Attendance Goals, Configuring Occupancy & Attendance Goals for an Office, About Configured Offices, and Configuring an Office.

entries.title: Enhanced Charts in Workplace Insights
body: The following enhancements are added to Workplace Insights:
- You can view occupancy and attendance chart metrics for your choice of units (e.g., numerical value, percentage, etc.).
- View occupancy and attendance data along with the configured goals in the Occupancy by Day and Attendance by Day widgets, respectively.
See image.
To learn more, see Analyzing a Workplace or Viewing Offices and Locations in a Chart.

entries.title: Enhanced Office Configuration
body: The following enhancements are available in the Add Office drawer when configuring an office:
- The Address field autopopulates when you enter the office address.
- The following fields are no longer available when configuring an office:
- City
- Country
- State/Province
See image.
To learn more, see Configuring an Office.

entries.title: Export Top Cities to CSV
body: You can export the data of the Top Cities widget to a CSV file by clicking the Export icon on the Workplace Insights page.
See image.
To learn more, see Analyzing Workplace Insights.

entries.title: Support for Scheduled Reports
body: You can schedule reports for an application's activity or inactivity data for regular (weekly, monthly, or quarterly) distribution via email and integrate with Workflow Automation in the Business Insights Admin Portal.
See image.
To learn more, see About Scheduled Reports, Scheduling Reports, About the Exclusion List, and Adding an Exclusion.

entries.title: Support for Workflow Automation
body: The Business Insights service supports Workflow Automation with third-party app integrations for managing Business Insights incidents, such as application license reclaim.
To learn more, see Integrating SaaS Application for Workflow Automation.

entries.title: Support for Custom Application Signatures
body: You can configure custom application signatures to pull data from specific application URLs for viewing business-critical metrics in the Business Insights Admin Portal.
See image.
To learn more, see About Application Configuration and Creating Custom Application Signatures.

entries.title: Enhanced Averages Section in Workplace Insights
body: The following updates are available in the Averages section on the Workplace Insights pages:
- You can view the total visits for the office capacity and assigned headcount.
- You can view the percentage increase or decrease in the averages widgets for the respective time frame, such as Month over Month (MoM), Week over Week (WoW), and Quarter over Quarter (QoQ).
See image.
To learn more, see Analyzing Workplace Insights, Viewing Offices and Locations in a Chart, and Analyzing a Workplace.

entries.title: Ability to Filter Workplace Insights by Days
body: A new filter option, Days, is added to the Workplace Insights pages to filter for specific days of the week and dates of the month within the selected time frame.
See image.
To learn more, see Analyzing Workplace Insights.

entries.title: Enhanced Workplace Insights
body: The following enhancements are available on the Workplace Insights page (Workplace > Workplace Insights):
- The Name filter is updated to the Type and Geolocation filter for a better filtering experience.
- The Averages section shows the number of users along with the percentage of users in the Average Occupancy and Peak / Low Occupancy widgets.
- A new widget, Top Cities, is added to display the office visit frequency for top cities.
- The Map View widget is divided into two tabs: Geography and Remote User Density.
See image.
To learn more, see Analyzing Workplace Insights.

entries.title: Business Insights Support for General Availability
body: The previous limited availability Business Insights service is now available for all customers.
# A Brief about the Business Insights Service

The Business Insights service provides 360-degree visibility into your organization's SaaS application usage and spending insights, along with workplace metrics to help you save money and manage your workplace efficiently.

Business Insights serves as a centralized engagement interface for all your licensed applications, provides the necessary information to effectively manage and optimize your application landscape, and also helps you conduct data-based office capacity planning and understand hour-by-hour office utilization down to city, office, department, and even employee levels.
Enabling Business Insights for your organization provides the following benefits:
- Discover App Usage: View application usage and other vital metrics for apps currently being used within your organization, including shadow IT apps.
- Engagement Data: Glance into the application's engagement ratio, spending trends, saving opportunities, inactive user data, usage by department, application overlaps, etc.
- Cost Control: Save money by reducing unnecessary application licenses and efficiently utilizing workplaces with rich insights and predictive cost-saving models.
- Workplace Insights: Optimize office overheads with details on what days employees spend in the office vs. hybrid vs. remote, as well as which departments come into the office most frequently.
- Manage Workplaces: Efficiently manage workplaces by analyzing data such as top and least-used offices, attendance, occupancy, visit span, and more.

- Back-to-Office Strategy: Leverage hour-by-hour office utilization data, and access weekly, monthly, and quarterly workplace usage data across all your office locations to make data-backed decisions on your back-to-office strategy.
To learn more, see What Is Zscaler Business Insights?

entries.title: Enhanced Workplace Insights for Attendance & Most Used Offices
body: The Workplace Insights page is enhanced with the following updates:
- A new widget, Attendance by Days per Week, is added.
- The existing Least Used section is updated to show both least and most used offices.
See image.
To learn more, see Analyzing Workplace Insights.

entries.title: View Reason for Missing Workplace Data
body: You can view the reason for a workplace's missing data. Hover over the Error icon next to the workplace name on the following Business Insights Admin Portal pages:
- Offices and Locations (Workplace > Offices and Locations)
- Configured Offices (Workplace > Workplace Settings)
See image.
To learn more, see About Configured Offices and About Offices and Locations.

entries.title: Ability to Download Active and Inactive Users
body: The following enhancements are available on the Engagement Index & Users tab on the Application Details page:
- The ability to filter the table data for a specific time frame.
- Two tabs, Active Users and Inactive Users, are added to the Users table.
- The Export option is added to download the table data into a CSV file.
See image.
To learn more, see Viewing Application Details.

entries.title: View Business Insights Reports
body: You can access and download the following Business Insights reports from the Reports page in the Business Insights Admin Portal:
- Applications Report
- Workplaces Report
See image.
To learn more, see Downloading Business Insights Reports.

entries.title: Viewing Application's Sanction Status
body: You can view the sanction status of applications in the Business Insights Admin Portal. This informs you whether the application's usage is sanctioned or not in your organization.
See image.
To learn more, see About All Applications, About Application Insights, and Viewing Application Details.

entries.title: Enhanced Workplace Insights & Configuration
body: The Workplace Insights and Configuration pages are enhanced with the following updates:
- A new option, Export as PDF, is added to the Workplace Insights and Offices and Locations pages.
- See image.
- The View icon is added for read-only admins on the Configured Offices page.
- See image.
- The existing Add Manually option is renamed to Add Office on the Configured Offices page.
- See image.
- A new option, Save and Add New, is added to the Add Office drawer when configuring an office.
- See image.
To learn more, see Analyzing Workplace Insights, About Offices and Locations, About Configured Offices, and Configuring an Office.

entries.title: Enhanced Office Configuration
body: The Configured Offices page is enhanced with the following updates:
- The existing option, Configure or Edit Offices, is renamed to Add with Template.
- Add Manually is a new option to support office configuration without a CSV file.
See image.
To learn more, see About Configured Offices and Configuring an Office.

entries.title: Revamped Workplace Insights
body: The following enhancements are available under the Workplace section in the Business Insights Admin Portal:
- The Workplace Insights page is revamped to show better insights for all your office sites.
- See image.
- A new page, Offices and Locations, is introduced to view your office sites from various perspectives, such as a list, maps, or charts.
- See image.
- The Cities, Departments, Offices, and Work Mode pages are no longer available. The metrics provided by these pages are now more accurately aligned and displayed on the new and revamped pages.
- See image.
To learn more, see Analyzing Workplace Insights, About Offices and Locations, Viewing Offices and Locations on a Map, Viewing Offices and Locations in a Chart, and Analyzing a Workplace.

entries.title: Support for Office Configuration
body: You can configure offices by accumulating traffic from various Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) locations, inferred office IP addresses, and other IP addresses under their corresponding offices to view accurate office-specific metrics.
As part of this enhancement, the Configured Offices page (Workplace > Configuration) is added in the Business Insights Admin Portal.
See image.
To learn more, see About Configured Offices and Configuring Offices.

entries.title: Business Insights Integration with ZIdentity
body: Business Insights supports the ZIdentity service that allows you to single sign-on (SSO) to the different Zscaler admin portals using a single set of login credentials.
If you are subscribed to the ZIdentity service, the Administrator and Administrator Management pages have limited functionalities.
To learn more, see What Is ZSLogin?, About Administrators, and Understanding Administrator Management Settings.

entries.title: Help Browser Support in Business Insights Admin Portal
body: The Zscaler Help Browser is available for all pages within the Business Insights Admin Portal. Through the Help Browser you can view Zscaler Help Portal articles in context with the page you're on, without leaving the Business Insights Admin Portal.
See image.
To learn more, see Using the Zscaler Help Browser.

entries.title: Filtering Workplace Insights by Last 7 Days
body: You can filter the Workplace Insights pages (Cities, Offices, Departments, and Work Mode) for the last 7 days.
See image.
To learn more, see About Workplace Insights.
